dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Mwahaha, at long last! The almighty dragonlord K'uhul Ajaw has shattered that which bound him, and graces the world with his majestic presence once more!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Kinich! We didn't expect to see you here!

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Oh... it's you two little... things.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! You little... how are you still so arrogant!?

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Hmph. Forget it. I'll let that slide for now, as I happen to be in a good mood today.

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: I had him locked up before, and just released him, so...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! So you just let him out? No wonder!

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Released, shmeleased! I totally was the one who broke free!

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Besides, Kinich, not like you even know what's good for yourself anyway. If these two chumps had an unfortunate accident, couldn't you make a fortune out of saving them?

choices.text: It's fine. That's just how Ajaw is.

response.speaker: Ajaw
response.text: Hmph! Looks like someone is only half-blind.

response.speaker: Kinich
response.text: Are the two of you here because of graffiti?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wha—? Kinich, how'd you know that?

response.speaker: Kinich
response.text: Members of the Graffiti Alliance have been active around here lately. There was some concern they might encounter danger while at work, and so I was commissioned to come look.

response.speaker: Kinich
response.text: Though with you here, there was never a need to worry in the first place.

response.speaker: Ajaw
response.text: Hey, that's right! This pasty little pixie doesn't even have the right to draw graffiti, much less get herself in danger!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Just what're you trying to say?

response.speaker: Ajaw
response.text: It's a rule of the Scions of the Canopy: Only those who pass the trial have the right to draw graffiti! You've gotta be brave enough to leap from the peaks over there, but do you have the guts?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Isn't that just bungee jumping? Paimon's heard of it, just an extreme sport, nothing special.

response.speaker: Ajaw
response.text: Oho, this is no ordinary extreme sport! It's a trial, you see, a trial!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So how's it different then?

response.speaker: Ajaw
response.text: You don't even know that? Pathetic. Fine, I'm willing to waste some of my precious time helping you be a bit less ignorant.

choices.text: Wow, you'd really do something nice for someone?

response.speaker: Ajaw
response.text: First, before you start climbing, you've gotta show your bravery by dumping everything but your clothes at the foot of the mountain. That means no ropes, no knives, no wind gliders, no nothing!

response.speaker: Ajaw
response.text: If you bring anything, even the teeniest doo-dad, it counts as disrespecting the trial and you instantly fail! Once you reach the summit, you've gotta run around it three times, and then...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And then what?

response.speaker: Ajaw
response.text: Then you leap! And then you relax your whole body.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Doesn't that just mean you fall down the mountain!?

response.speaker: Ajaw
response.text: Naw, you'd be fine! If even an iota of what I said was false, then may I immediately be imprison— HEY! Wait, servant, what're you doing, a—

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Kinich, he was just getting to the most important part! Why'd you lock him up?

response.speaker: Kinich
response.text: Paimon, we generally call jumping off a high cliff without a rope "suicide."

response.speaker: Kinich
response.text: The reason for his earlier confinement was because he attempted to trick members of the Graffiti Alliance into jumping off cliffs.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Argh! That loathsome little lizard! He was up to no good after all! He deserves to get locked up again!

response.speaker: Kinich
response.text: My apologies to both of you. In any case, please do pay attention to your safety around here. I still need to patrol a few other areas, so I'll be taking my leave now.

response.speaker: Kinich
response.text: As for the members of the Graffiti Alliance, don't you worry. I'll handle their safety.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay! Hopefully it won't be too much trouble.

response.speaker: Kinich
response.text: No trouble at all. It's part of the commission, after all.

response.speaker: Kinich
response.text: As for Ajaw, after his time out is over, I'll let him experience the thrill of ropeless bungee jumping for himself.

choices.text: Where's the real Ajaw and what'd you do with him?
It's fine. I'm not the type to stoop to squabbling with little things like him.

response.speaker: Ajaw
response.text: I'm no "little thing"!
